newsitem.title: UK: Wickes to launch rights prospectus-paper.
newsitem.headline: Wickes to launch rights prospectus-paper.

text.p: Building materials merchants Wickes Plc, whose former senior managers are under investigation by the Serious Fraud Office, is expected to launch the prospectus for a 50 million stg rights issue next week, the "Times" said on Tuesday.

The company was earlier expected to try to raise about 30 million stg, but has since realised it needs more cash to plug the gap left by three years of profit overstatement, the Times said. The recapitalisation will allow trading in Wickes shares, suspended in June after accounting irregularities were uncovered, to resume in January, the Times said.

Misleading accounting at Wickes was uncovered in June. This had led to the overstatement of group profits by tens of millions of pounds over the last five years. The news rocked the share price, leading to its suspension.
